items.judul: Why Half of Indonesia Lives on One Island
items.deskripsi:
After watching, you can explain why more than half of Indonesia lives on Java, and why 75 years of moving people off the island barely changed that.

How Jakarta's crowd got to work on Tokyo's old trains: https://youtu.be/XC3g2ZL9lPE

facebook.deskripsi:
More than half of Indonesia lives on Java, an island about the size of England. For 75 years the country has moved people off it. Java grew anyway.

This video follows the reasons: the volcanic soil, the flooded rice fields, a Dutch decision from 1830, and why the crowd stays today.

Narration uses a synthetic voice.
